column8: Preserve the current input-method-capable launcher; changed AUR recipe or unavailable source blocks rather than falling back
Official Fuzzel lacks the confirmed current IME behavior and must not be installed as a guessed fallback
The current shared DMS desktop owns notifications in both selected compositor sessions
Mako is absent on the golden host and survives only as stale starter history, not a target package
Current greetd state is physical-host evidence but login-manager changes remain outside the executable restore path
The superseded SDDM fallback must never be installed or enabled automatically
The observed rolling greeter package violates the fixed-source requirement and is never installed by this release
